Clinical validation and literature review of robot-assisted cerebral angiography

notes: NMPA Class III approval 2023-03-13 per cn-healthcare.com 2023-04-28 (named 易度河北, product VAS HERO). CONFLICT: other press attributes the first NMPA approval (2023-03-14, 260-pt, 100% success) to Beijing Wansi (万思) Medical; the 260-pt 3-centre trial matches liu2024_efficacy (YDHB-NS01), so Wansi attribution looks like a mix-up; unresolved without the NMPA database.
